newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nagasakiya up on buying in cheaper issues.
newsitem.headline: Nagasakiya up on buying in cheaper issues.

text.p: Shares of Japanese supermarket chain operator Nagasakiya Co Ltd rose on Tuesday as investors interested in low-priced shares bought the issue, brokers said.
By 0335 GMT, the shares had gained 32 yen or 8.70 percent to 400.
Retailers were ranked within the top five gaining sectors at the end of the two-hour morning session.
"The entire index is moving higher and low-priced shares are being towed higher also," a salesman at a medium-size brokerage said.
Some brokers said that there were some investors who were speculating that the firm's earnings were on the road to recovery.
